name: Obaa-chan, Mama wa Sasete Kureta yo? ~Musuko Mitai ni Ubawasenai wa!~
original_name: おばあちゃん、ママはさせてくれたよ？ ～息子みたいに奪わせないわ！～
source:
My grandson Kazuma came to visit for the long vacation.
I often hear people say, "When my grandchildren come home for the holidays, it's fun, but tiring."

(It'd be fine if it was just my grandson, if it was just my grandson...)

The problem is that my son's wife is also staying with me for an extended period of time.
My son, Shinichi, is living in the city for work.
Living with my son's wife without my son is really exhausting.

(Well, I guess Mikako is more exhausted than I am...)

Then one day, while I was taking a bath, I suddenly felt something strange.
I felt someone's gaze on me.
I looked over to the bathroom door and it was slightly open.
The peeping person was...

That night, I slept with my grandson.
Ever since my son's wife and grandson came to live with me, we've been sleeping together like this quite often.
I was doing it because my grandson begged me to.

(I'm a bit worried, after what happened...)

I didn't think anything bad will happen.
But...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1135936]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我的孙子和真在长假期间来看我。
我经常听到人们说：“当我的孙子们放假回家时，很有趣，但也很累。”

（如果只是我的孙子就好了，如果只是我的孙子就好了……）问题是我儿子的妻子也长期和我住在一起。
我的儿子新一因为工作而住在城里。
和儿子的妻子一起生活，没有儿子，真的很累。

（嗯，我猜美佳子比我还累……）有一天，我洗澡的时候，突然感觉有些奇怪。
我感觉到有人在注视着我。
我看向浴室的门，门微微开着。
那个偷看的人是……

那天晚上，我和孙子一起睡。
自从我儿媳妇和孙子来我家住之后，我们就经常这样睡在一起。
我这样做是因为我的孙子恳求我这样做。

（发生这件事后我有点担心……）我没想到会发生什么不好的事情。
但是…

[来自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1135936]Getchu[/url]]
